data.summary_en: Athanor built a real-GPU agent-native autonomous post-training system: four Claude Opus 5.5 agents autonomously train Qwen3-4B-Base in 104-hour campaign, raising six-task development set 15.9→67.3 and held-out 9.2→48.2; authors claim first frontier agent teams autonomously post-train raw base models into cross-domain general models, average-matching/exceeding official Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507.
